n8fddbf0878.headline: Manufacturing activity remains in contractionary territory
n8fddbf0878.summary: The Absa Purchasing Managers' Index fell 1.9 points to 46.2 in December, keeping manufacturing in contractionary territory. The Q4 average was 49 points.
n8fddbf0878.why: The PMI is a leading gauge of manufacturing health, which influences South African growth expectations and the rand.

nc0ef79e10c.headline: Prices of Industrial Products Up 8%
nc0ef79e10c.summary: Industrial producer prices were 7.9 per cent higher in November 2024 than a year earlier, with export prices up 10.2 per cent, mainly due to the weaker forint.
nc0ef79e10c.why: Producer price inflation feeds into consumer prices and influences the central bank's policy path and currency outlook.

n2138ae97d8.headline: G Mining Ventures Celebrates 2024 Achievements and Gold Production of 63,566 Ounces
n2138ae97d8.summary: G Mining Ventures reported 2024 gold production of 63,566 ounces and said its Tocantinzinho mine was completed on time and on budget.
n2138ae97d8.why: G Mining Ventures is a gold miner, and its output and project delivery affect gold supply and the valuation of its shares.

n9d66747cf9.headline: Standard Glass Lining IPO Day 3: Check subscription status, GMP and other details - BusinessToday
n9d66747cf9.summary: Standard Glass Lining Technology is selling shares at Rs 133-140 apiece to raise Rs 410.05 crore in its IPO, which is on its third day of subscription.
n9d66747cf9.why: An IPO is a company's first sale of shares to the public, and its pricing and subscription levels indicate investor demand for new listings.

n7a8e447052.headline: Interest Rate Clarity, Narrower Bid-Ask Spreads Mean Busier Year for CRE Financing
n7a8e447052.summary: Commercial real estate financing volume is expected to rise this year after a 2024 rebound, despite some unresolved uncertainties.
n7a8e447052.why: Commercial real estate financing depends on interest rates and lending conditions, which affect property transactions, developer activity and bank loan books.

n13d8c44487.headline: Gemfields urges Zambia to reconsider emerald export duty
n13d8c44487.summary: London-listed Gemfields said it will lobby the Zambian government to suspend a reinstated 15% export duty on precious gemstones, effective January 1, which would hit emeralds from its 75%-owned Kagem Mining.
n13d8c44487.why: Gemfields is a London-listed coloured gemstone miner, and its Kagem emerald mine in Zambia is a major source of its revenue.

nb49b030768.headline: Pakistan to honour IMF commitments, but excessive taxes unsustainable: PM Shehbaz
nb49b030768.summary: Speaking at the Pakistan Stock Exchange, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said Pakistan would honour its IMF commitments but described excessive taxes as unsustainable.
nb49b030768.why: The IMF bailout programme shapes Pakistan's fiscal policy, and tax levels affect corporate profitability, investment and the country's debt sustainability.

nb7f6ebaf8e.headline: Lufthansa to acquire stake in Italy's ITA next week, source says
nb7f6ebaf8e.summary: Lufthansa is set to acquire a stake in Italian state-owned airline ITA on January 13, a source told Reuters, closing years of talks.
nb7f6ebaf8e.why: Lufthansa is a major German airline group, and ITA Airways is the Italian national carrier, so the stake would deepen Lufthansa's presence in Italy.

nd6b63a59c2.headline: MSC INDUSTRIAL SUPPLY CO. REPORTS FISCAL 2025 FIRST QUARTER RESULTS
nd6b63a59c2.summary: MSC Industrial Supply Co. released its fiscal 2025 first-quarter results, as a North American distributor of industrial products.
nd6b63a59c2.why: MSC Industrial is a New York-listed distributor of industrial maintenance and metalworking products, and its quarterly results signal demand in US industrial markets.

n55c345949f.headline: Greece Introduces New Tax and Rental Framework for Airbnb Properties Amid Housing Crisis
n55c345949f.summary: From January 1, Greece will stop issuing Airbnb licences in several downtown Athens districts, under a revised tax and rental framework that distinguishes short-term from long-term rentals.
n55c345949f.why: Short-term rental platforms like Airbnb depend on local regulation, and tighter rules affect property owners, rental supply and municipal tax revenue.

n0c0f832d68.headline: Czech Republic open to Trump's call for higher NATO defence targets
n0c0f832d68.summary: The Czech Republic said it is open to spending more on defence, as demanded by US President-elect Donald Trump, Prime Minister Petr Fiala said.
n0c0f832d68.why: NATO defence spending targets shape government budgets and defence procurement, which affect industrial and defence-sector demand in member states.

n48e565700a.headline: Samsung Q4 profit outlook misses estimates by big margin
n48e565700a.summary: Samsung's fourth-quarter operating profit estimate missed analyst forecasts by a large margin. The company lagged rival SK Hynix in supplying high-end chips to Nvidia.
n48e565700a.why: Samsung is a leading memory chip and electronics maker, and its chip supply position affects global semiconductor and AI hardware markets.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: A profit outlook well below expectations weighs on the company's share price.

nb8a6612ca0.headline: Government misses 2024 inflation target as December rate goes up marginally to 23.8%
nb8a6612ca0.summary: Ghana's inflation rose marginally to 23.8 per cent in December 2024 from 23 per cent in November. That is above the revised 18 per cent end-of-year target set by the Bank of Ghana.
nb8a6612ca0.why: Inflation trends guide central bank rate decisions, which affect borrowing costs and currency stability.

n9f16415c47.headline: Apax Global Alpha Portfolio Company Paycor To Be Acquired By Paychex
n9f16415c47.summary: Paychex is acquiring Paycor HCM, a portfolio company of Apax Global Alpha. The deal values AGA's investment at €38m and lifts its NAV by 69 per cent.
n9f16415c47.why: Paychex is a US payroll and HR services provider, and consolidation in this sector affects competition among HR software firms.

n303d159945.headline: Mahama promises fairer tax system
n303d159945.summary: John Dramani Mahama was sworn in as Ghana's sixth president by the Chief Justice. He pledged a fairer tax system after returning to power on the NDC ticket.
n303d159945.why: Tax policy and government direction shape investment conditions, fiscal revenue and business confidence in Ghana.

nd978613b44.headline: Who’s afraid of Donald Trump? | World News
nd978613b44.summary: Analysis argues fears of global trade disruption from Trump's proposed tariffs on Canada, Mexico and the BRICS bloc are exaggerated, as most countries have adapted.
nd978613b44.why: Tariffs on major trading partners can reshape supply chains, currency flows and corporate margins across North America and emerging markets.

n4c1a3f4fa6.headline: Chile’s year-end copper windfall signals mines are recovering
n4c1a3f4fa6.summary: Chile's copper export revenue rose to $4.66 billion in December, up 10% from November and 13% year on year, despite lower average prices, according to the central bank. The data point to mines recovering.
n4c1a3f4fa6.why: Chile is the world's top copper producer, so its export revenue is a closely watched indicator for global copper supply and the country's economy. Copper is a key input for construction, electrical and industrial demand.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Chile's mine recovery signals higher copper output and export volumes, though the effect on global prices is unclear from the data.

n17a66a65dd.headline: Wall Street little changed as investors assess inflation path
n17a66a65dd.summary: US stocks ended little changed in a choppy session as investors digested two conflicting jobs reports and minutes from the Federal Reserve. A report said Donald Trump was mulling a national economic emergency declaration on inflation.
n17a66a65dd.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and investor expectations about Federal Reserve policy and inflation drive its direction. Conflicting labour data complicates forecasts for interest rates.

n0c3a165e5e.headline: Qatar Energy Updates Oil Pricing Strategy | Headlines
n0c3a165e5e.summary: Qatar Energy set its February official selling price for marine crude at a $0.45 per barrel premium over the Oman/Dubai average. The land crude price was set at a $0.30 per barrel premium.
n0c3a165e5e.why: Qatar Energy is the state-owned producer of Qatari oil and LNG, and its monthly official selling prices guide the pricing of crude cargoes sold to Asian buyers. These prices are benchmarked against Middle East crude grades.

n31728de3f3.headline: El Salvador grants digital asset license to Bitfinex derivatives - Invezz
n31728de3f3.summary: El Salvador has granted a digital asset license to Bitfinex derivatives, according to the source report.
n31728de3f3.why: El Salvador has adopted bitcoin as legal tender and has been building a regulatory framework for digital asset firms, which affects crypto market access.

n123659eb2c.headline: Wipro to share Q3 results on Friday, January 17; here's earnings preview - BusinessToday
n123659eb2c.summary: Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities expects Wipro to report a 16.6% year-on-year rise in adjusted net profit to Rs 3,148.40 crore, with total contract value of $1.1-1.4 billion.
n123659eb2c.why: Wipro is an Indian IT services company whose quarterly results and deal wins are watched as indicators of global outsourcing demand.

impacts.name: Wipro
impacts.why: Quarterly results are due and analysts expect profit growth and a specified contract value range.

n8d742f17d4.headline: Roadshow to advise farmers on succession planning and inheritance tax changes
n8d742f17d4.summary: A Welsh Government farming advice service will hold a roadshow around Wales. It will offer help with succession planning in light of changes to inheritance tax.
n8d742f17d4.why: Inheritance tax rules affect how farm businesses are passed on, which influences land ownership and the agricultural sector's finances.

n6a989d369c.headline: Ominvest secures $500 million facility
n6a989d369c.summary: Oman International Development and Investment Company, known as Ominvest, has secured a five-year $500 million facility. The company is described as a leading investment powerhouse in Oman.
n6a989d369c.why: Ominvest is an Omani state-linked investment company, and large facilities support its investment and development activity. Such financing affects Oman's corporate credit and project pipeline.

n4bcdeb40e0.headline: ADNOC’s Aggressive Push for Global Energy Assets
n4bcdeb40e0.summary: ADNOC's internationalisation strategy spans shipping, downstream investments and lower-carbon initiatives. The approach makes it a stronger competitor among international oil companies.
n4bcdeb40e0.why: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company is a state-owned UAE oil major whose global expansion affects competition in oil, gas and refining.

n407e94f308.headline: Microsoft to partner with Meity to train 500,000 people in AI skills; to build strategic partnerships with several firms - BusinessToday
n407e94f308.summary: Microsoft will partner with India's Ministry of Electronics and IT (Meity) to train 500,000 people in AI skills. It also plans strategic partnerships with several firms.
n407e94f308.why: Microsoft is a major cloud and AI software company, and its AI investments in India shape the country's technology talent pool and enterprise demand.

n54062d39be.headline: Likewise Group Reports £150.8m Revenue Milestone And 2025 Expansion Plans
n54062d39be.summary: Likewise Group plc reported 2024 revenue of £150.8 million, with strong logistics advancements. The company also set out strategic expansion plans for 2025.
n54062d39be.why: Likewise Group is a UK logistics-focused company, and revenue growth and expansion plans are central to how investors assess its performance.

nc8631676c8.headline: JP Morgan: Australia
nc8631676c8.summary: Median house rents rose 51% and median unit rents 40% between December 2019 and September 2024, according to Domain data cited by JP Morgan. Asking rents have risen more than 40% since the pandemic.
nc8631676c8.why: Rents feed directly into Australia's inflation measures, which shape Reserve Bank of Australia rate decisions and the outlook for household spending and property assets.

nb5b08a16a6.headline: Heineken's United Breweries halts sales in Indian state
nb5b08a16a6.summary: Heineken-owned United Breweries has stopped supplying beer to the Indian state of Telangana. The company said the state's refusal to allow price rises has caused it huge losses.
nb5b08a16a6.why: Heineken is a Dutch brewer, and United Breweries is its Indian subsidiary, so pricing disputes with state regulators directly affect group earnings in India.

impacts.name: Heineken
impacts.why: Heineken owns United Breweries, so losses in its Indian unit affect the group.

n4214456fb9.headline: Irish food and drink export value hit €17bn in 2024 – Bord Bia
n4214456fb9.summary: Irish food and drink export value hit €17 billion in 2024, according to Bord Bia. Higher pricing was the main driver of growth as cost pressures and inflation continued to affect businesses.
n4214456fb9.why: Food and drink is a major Irish export sector, and export values are a key indicator of the agri-food industry's contribution to the Irish economy.

n8c60c1cc4e.headline: Gas oversupply abroad meets shortages at home
n8c60c1cc4e.summary: Global liquefied natural gas supply is expected to ramp up in 2025, mostly from North America, after project delays pushed output into later years. This is likely to weigh on local producers and federal government revenue, according to the AFR.
n8c60c1cc4e.why: LNG prices and volumes affect gas exporters such as Australia, whose producers and tax receipts depend on global LNG market conditions.

ncd93bbd54c.headline: Nigerian banks gave out N76 trillion in loans to private businesses in 2024
ncd93bbd54c.summary: Nigerian banks gave out N76 trillion in loans in 2024. Private sector loans grew 27%, while loans to the government grew 54%.
ncd93bbd54c.why: Bank lending indicates credit conditions in Nigeria, and heavy government borrowing can crowd out lending to private firms.

ndd09a2ec60.headline: Inflation data great news for RBA
ndd09a2ec60.summary: The ABS monthly inflation gauge recorded headline CPI inflation of 2.3% year-on-year in November, above expectations of 2.2%. Timing of electricity rebates contributed to the rise.
ndd09a2ec60.why: Inflation readings guide the Reserve Bank of Australia's interest-rate decisions, which influence borrowing costs, the currency and asset valuations.

n5438d9d9f3.headline: Dumsor: $90m needed to avert looming power crisis – GRIDCo report
n5438d9d9f3.summary: Ghana urgently needs nearly $90 million to avert a looming power crisis caused by insufficient fuel supplies for thermal plants, according to a GRIDCo report.
n5438d9d9f3.why: GRIDCo operates Ghana's national electricity transmission grid, and power shortages affect households, industry and the broader economy.

n3f9906c862.headline: Sebi imposes Rs 9 lakh penalty on stock broker whose 1,103 clients were
n3f9906c862.summary: India's markets regulator SEBI penalised Stockholding Services Rs 9 lakh over irregularities in client data. Over 1,100 accounts listed 'dependent children' aged 34 to 100, breaching norms.
n3f9906c862.why: SEBI regulates India's securities markets, and its enforcement actions set compliance standards for brokers and investor protection.

n6ea1242ce1.headline: Court Declares Forex Charges Against Emefiele Unconstitutional, Retains Jurisdiction On Other Counts
n6ea1242ce1.summary: The Lagos State Special Offences Court struck out EFCC charges against former CBN Governor Godwin Emefiele over forex allocation without a bid, declaring them unconstitutional, while retaining jurisdiction over other counts.
n6ea1242ce1.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria sets monetary and foreign exchange policy, so legal proceedings involving its former governor affect confidence in the country's FX regime.

n152ab28afc.headline: Early rate-cut hopes alive as core inflation eases
n152ab28afc.summary: Hopes of a February interest-rate cut have been rekindled as core inflation subsides, though the input notes strong jobs data. The input does not specify the central bank's decision.
n152ab28afc.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, and inflation and jobs data drive expectations for borrowing costs.

n9d11d28ba3.headline: Stock market update: FMCG stocks  down  as market  falls
n9d11d28ba3.summary: The 30-share BSE Sensex closed down 50.62 points at 78,148.49, with FMCG stocks lower as the market fell. The move was small in percentage terms.
n9d11d28ba3.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and is the main benchmark for Indian equities.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index closed lower on the day.

n41a27aad02.headline: Indian Railways meets budget targets with timely completion of projects in 2024-25
n41a27aad02.summary: Indian Railways has spent 76 per cent of its budgetary allocation and met budget targets through timely completion of projects in 2024-25.
n41a27aad02.why: Indian Railways is a large state-run infrastructure operator, and its capital spending supports construction and rail equipment suppliers.

n1f8665c1e6.headline: Holiday Slowdown Arrives in December with Some Silver Linings For Buyers
n1f8665c1e6.summary: December 2024 saw a 22.0% growth in homes actively for sale compared with a year earlier, according to the December Monthly Housing report. The holiday slowdown was noted.
n1f8665c1e6.why: Housing inventory and sales data feed into expectations for mortgage demand, home builders and the wider US economy.

n47109882e2.headline: Private equity investments in India surge to $15 billion in 2024, a 46.2 pc growth
n47109882e2.summary: Private equity investments in India surged to $15 billion in 2024, a 46.2% increase. Growth was driven by healthcare and pharmaceuticals, consumer industries and technology.
n47109882e2.why: Private equity flows indicate investor appetite for Indian companies and affect deal activity and valuations in key sectors.

n9f2d93ffc1.headline: Portugal house prices rise due to demand from Britons - with higher UK taxes a factor
n9f2d93ffc1.summary: Portuguese house prices are rising due to demand from Britons, with estate agents saying higher UK taxes after the Budget are a factor.
n9f2d93ffc1.why: Foreign buyer demand influences property prices and housing market trends in Portugal.

nea472cb639.headline: Commerce advisor sees no reason for increase in rice prices
nea472cb639.summary: Bangladesh's commerce adviser Sheikh Bashir Uddin said there is no reason for higher rice prices and blamed temporary hoarding.
nea472cb639.why: Rice is a staple food in Bangladesh, so its price shapes inflation and household budgets.

nf19cef288c.headline: Eye care chain Dr. Agarwal Health Care gets Sebi nod for IPO
nf19cef288c.summary: Dr. Agarwal Health Care, backed by Temasek and TPG, received approval from India's market regulator Sebi for its initial public offering. The eye care chain's listing was cleared by the regulator.
nf19cef288c.why: The Securities and Exchange Board of India regulates public share offerings, and approval marks a step toward the company listing on Indian exchanges.

n7acdbb42ae.headline: Taiwan’s trade surplus with US jumps to record - Taipei Times
n7acdbb42ae.summary: Taiwan's trade surplus with the US reached a record last year, as net exports to the US rose 83.5% to US$64.9 billion. The imbalance could draw criticism from incoming US President Donald Trump.
n7acdbb42ae.why: The US-Taiwan trade balance matters for global supply chains, especially semiconductors, and is a focus of US trade policy.

na079601a36.headline: Income tax doubled for motorcycle, refrigerator, and air-conditioner companies
na079601a36.summary: The income tax rate for motorcycle, refrigerator and air-conditioner companies in Bangladesh rises from 10 percent to 20 percent. The change affects manufacturers in these consumer durables sectors.
na079601a36.why: Changes in corporate tax rates alter after-tax earnings for manufacturers and can shift pricing and investment decisions in affected sectors.

nd330392796.headline: Executive Yuan says police officer pension reform bill unconstitutional - Taipei Times
nd330392796.summary: Taiwan's Executive Yuan said a police pension reform bill passed by the legislature contravenes the Constitution and the budget law. It will discuss remedial options with experts and the Examination Yuan.
nd330392796.why: Pension liabilities are a major component of government fiscal obligations, so disputes over public pension reform affect public finances.

n74f720366d.headline: Eight Indiana coal sites offer 'intriguing opportunities' for nuclear plants, per new Purdue study • Indiana Capital Chronicle
n74f720366d.summary: A new Purdue University study found that eight current or former coal sites across Indiana could serve as new nuclear power opportunities.
n74f720366d.why: Repurposing existing coal sites can lower the cost and permitting burden of new nuclear power plants, which matters for utilities and energy investors.

n572cc77bf9.headline: Valeura Energy Achieves Record Oil Production And Sales Volumes In Q4
n572cc77bf9.summary: Valeura Energy reported record oil production in the fourth quarter of 2024, ending the year at 22,825 barrels per day. The company also reported strong financials and outlined growth plans for 2025.
n572cc77bf9.why: Valeura is a Vancouver-based oil producer, and its production levels and cash flow depend on crude prices and output from its assets.

n3a58aa80c9.headline: Euro zone households likely to keep saving to rebuild wealth, ECB says
n3a58aa80c9.summary: Euro zone households could keep saving a large portion of their income to rebuild wealth lost to high inflation, the European Central Bank argued, suggesting subdued consumption.
n3a58aa80c9.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and household saving and spending shape growth and inflation there.

n13c7edac55.headline: German industrial orders, retail sales drop in November
n13c7edac55.summary: German industrial orders and retail sales unexpectedly fell in November, reigniting recession fears after the euro zone's largest economy barely grew in the third quarter.
n13c7edac55.why: Germany is the euro zone's largest economy, so its industrial and consumer data influence regional growth expectations and the euro.

n2a5e550cee.headline: Why Scotch whisky needs to urgently prepare for potential tariffs
n2a5e550cee.summary: Scotch whisky needs to prepare urgently for potential tariffs, as Donald Trump's influence before his inauguration is already shaping policy expectations beyond the United States, including in Scotland.
n2a5e550cee.why: The US is a major export market for Scotch whisky, so US tariffs would directly affect producer revenues.

nc33418ef2f.headline: RBI's credit reporting rules: How would this affect loan borrowers; check details - BusinessToday
nc33418ef2f.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's new credit reporting rules shift the reporting cycle away from the previous monthly schedule to reflect borrowers' financial activity more accurately.
nc33418ef2f.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank and regulator, and credit reporting determines how lenders assess borrower risk.

n06a8844803.headline: Starknet launches SN Stack, allowing developers to build custom chains
n06a8844803.summary: Starknet has launched the Starknet (SN) Stack, which lets anyone build a custom blockchain using the zero-knowledge technology that powers Starknet.
n06a8844803.why: Starknet is a zero-knowledge rollup network on Ethereum, and developer tooling affects adoption and activity on layer-2 blockchains.

n7fa9748121.headline: Indonesia to make resources exporters keep earnings at home for a year
n7fa9748121.summary: Indonesia plans to require natural resource exporters to keep their export proceeds in the country for at least one year, up from the current three months, the chief economic minister said.
n7fa9748121.why: Export proceeds retention rules affect foreign currency flows and the liquidity available to exporters, which matters for commodity producers and the rupiah.

n68ac2cc565.headline: Morning Bid: Bonds flashing red,
n68ac2cc565.summary: Long-term U.S. Treasury yields rose sharply at the start of the year, raising government borrowing costs globally. Analysts cited fiscal policy and interest-rate fears.
n68ac2cc565.why: US Treasuries are the benchmark risk-free government debt, so their yields feed into borrowing costs and asset valuations worldwide.
n68ac2cc565.why_moved: Input cites fiscal policy and interest-rate fears rebuilding a risk premium in debt markets, pushing long-term Treasury yields higher.

nc54e8b60bd.headline: REVEALED: First time buyers taking on more debt than UK 'since Celtic Tiger years'
nc54e8b60bd.summary: First-time buyers in Ireland are taking on more debt than in the UK, according to a report. MyHome Property predicts a 4% rise in Irish house prices in 2025.
nc54e8b60bd.why: Household mortgage debt and house prices shape bank lending and the broader consumer economy.

nf334450558.headline: China expands consumer trade-in scheme to revive economic growth
nf334450558.summary: China's central government has so far allocated $11.05 billion for consumer goods trade-ins in 2025, expanding the scheme to revive economic growth and support consumption.
nf334450558.why: Consumer spending is a major driver of China's economy, and state stimulus for durable goods affects retail, autos and appliance demand.

n1bdecb1d80.headline: Malaysia unveils tax breaks for new economic zone with Singapore
n1bdecb1d80.summary: Malaysia unveiled tax incentives to attract investors to its joint special economic zone with Singapore. The zone aims to add US$26 billion per year to the Malaysian economy by 2030.
n1bdecb1d80.why: Special economic zones offer tax and regulatory incentives to attract foreign direct investment and manufacturing into a specific region.

n794b55ef78.headline: National Highway Authority comes under fire in Sindh PA over steep hike in toll tax
n794b55ef78.summary: Opposition and treasury members in the Sindh Provincial Assembly joined to demand withdrawal of a steep toll tax hike by the National Highway Authority. The decision has drawn criticism in the house.
n794b55ef78.why: Toll rates affect transport costs for freight and logistics operators, and government fee decisions can influence the investment climate for infrastructure.

n54297bc6f8.headline: Dow slides; S&P flatline as Maplebear jumps, Exxon and Shell dip - Invezz
n54297bc6f8.summary: The Dow slid while the S&P 500 was flat, as Maplebear jumped and Exxon Mobil and Shell fell. The report was carried by Invezz.
n54297bc6f8.why: The Dow and S&P 500 are the main US equity benchmarks, so their daily direction shapes investor sentiment. Exxon Mobil and Shell are major integrated oil companies whose shares track crude prices.

n2b752e682b.headline: India, Sri Lanka agree to revive ETCA talks - Indian envoy - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
n2b752e682b.summary: India and Sri Lanka agreed to revive talks on the Economic and Technological Cooperation Agreement, according to India's High Commissioner to Sri Lanka. The agreement was reached during President Anura Kumara Dissanayake's visit to New Delhi.
n2b752e682b.why: Economic and Technological Cooperation Agreements set rules for trade, investment and services between two countries. Revived talks can affect bilateral trade flows and investment access.

n9e484e82a3.headline: Fatima Fertilizer commemorates sixth Kissan Day to celebrate Pakistan’s farmers
n9e484e82a3.summary: An analyst said Pakistani stocks remained under pressure amid political uncertainty and IMF levies on industrial captive power plants. The security situation was also cited.
n9e484e82a3.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi is the main equity market for Pakistan, and its moves reflect domestic politics and IMF-linked fiscal policy.
n9e484e82a3.why_moved: The input cites political uncertainty, the security situation, and IMF levies on industrial captive power plants as pressures on stocks.

n6c608f28b1.headline: Clarksons 2024 Global Shipbuilding Review Released
n6c608f28b1.summary: Clarksons Research has released its annual review of shipbuilding markets, including full-year 2024 data. The review tracks the sector's latest market developments.
n6c608f28b1.why: Clarksons is a London-based shipping research and services firm. Shipbuilding data signals future vessel supply and freight-market conditions.

n390ebf261e.headline: Potential contenders to replace Trudeau as Canadian prime minister
n390ebf261e.summary: Canada's ruling Liberal Party is looking for a new leader to replace Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, who announced he intends to step down. The party has not released details on the process.
n390ebf261e.why: The prime minister leads Canada's federal government, so leadership changes can shift fiscal, trade and regulatory policy that matters to investors.

nb52cf0b7e0.headline: China's viral wild boar hunters attract fame and concern
nb52cf0b7e0.summary: Hunters in China's Qinling mountains attract social media attention while addressing local farmers' livelihoods.
nb52cf0b7e0.why: Wildlife management and rural livelihoods are part of China's broader rural development and environmental policies.

nd09fefe4d3.headline: Recapitalisation: GTCO Raises N209bn Through Equity Capital Programme
nd09fefe4d3.summary: Guaranty Trust Holding Company (GTCO) Nigeria raised N209.41 billion through its equity capital increase.
nd09fefe4d3.why: The capital raise supports bank expansion and investment, influencing Nigeria's financial sector stability.

n9d5267e1af.headline: Sensex  falls! These  stocks are down 5% or more on BSE
n9d5267e1af.summary: The Indian Sensex declined as 38 stocks dropped over 5%, reflecting broad market weakness amid global and domestic concerns.
n9d5267e1af.why: Market declines can influence investor sentiment and capital flows in India’s equity markets.

n8fbd18e4a5.headline: Industry Stakeholders Seek Key Economic Reforms For Growth In 2025
n8fbd18e4a5.summary: Business leaders urge the Nigerian government to implement key reforms to support sustainable economic growth.
